why: Source: "Attacks made with this model’s Kustom Krumpa weapon can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls." (NR melee.txt l.147-148). It works only for that weapon on the models that have it: NR l.91 "2x Nob w/ Kustom Krumpa and Paired Krumpas — Kustom Krumpa, Paired Krumpas", and BSData has the Paired Krumpas upgrade only on that model. weapon:'Kustom Krumpa' matches the data.js melee row and NR "Kustom Krumpa (War Horde) (x10) - Nobz" (l.116) exactly, and the when names those Nobs, so keeping it out of "Whole unit" is right. The rendered datasheet keeps the Kustom Krumpa ×10 row unchanged (there is no set) and prints this line in its own box after the Whole unit and Hit ’Em Harder notes.
